project.ItemDescription:
“这次，我会战胜恐惧！” "This time,I'll overcome my fear!"
为了克服内心的恐惧，这位年轻的牧师来到了这片黑暗之地。她善于抚慰队伍的心灵，帮助队伍抵御未知的恐怖。 A young cleric came to this dark place to overcome the deepen fearness in her heart. She is skilled at soothing the team's spirits and helping the team withstand unknown terrors.
[h3]技能 Skills[/h3] （等技能确定了再写）
[h3]特征 Features[/h3] ·大量的专属语音 Extensive custom voice lines
·本体，CC，CoM饰品 A set of vanilla ,Crimson Court ,Color of Madness trinkets
·中文，英文本地化 Including schinese ,english localization
·信仰：有信仰 The Cleric is religous
·区域建筑加成：圣光祭坛 District:Altar of Light
牧师是一位我的幻想世界观的主要人物之一，也是第一个想法落地的项目，希望大家玩的开心！ The Cleric mod is one of the main characters from my original fantasy project ,and also an first idea that was realized .I'll be appreciated if you enjoyed it.
感谢你让她来到哈姆雷特镇！ Thank you for giving her a place in your Hamlet.
(Please forgive my poor English...)
